## Publication Information

**Date:** 1901

**Genre:** Non-fiction

**Publisher:** <i>Friendly Leaves</i> (February 1901) 83-4.

**Notes:** In series 'Leaves for the Months', several which are unsigned, but which are attributed to CMY in her obituary in <i>Friendly Leaves</i>.
